en.title: Shoot-Off Rules
en.excerpt: Learn the rules for elimination tie-breaks, single-arrow shoot-offs, team shoot-offs, and Closest-to-Center (CTC) measurement procedures in Archeris.
en.content:
When a head-to-head elimination match ends in a deadlock after the regulation number of sets or ends, the match winner is decided via a sudden-death tie-break known as a Shoot-Off (Satu Panah Penentuan).

1. When Does a Shoot-Off Occur?

A shoot-off is immediately triggered under the following conditions:

  • Set System (Recurve / Barebow Individual): When the match score is tied at 5 - 5 after 5 sets.
  • Set System (Recurve Team / Mixed Team): When the match score is tied at 4 - 4 after 4 sets.
  • Cumulative System (Compound Individual): When the total cumulative score is equal after 5 ends (15 arrows).
  • Cumulative System (Compound Team): When the total score is equal after 4 ends (24 arrows / 16 arrows for Mixed Team).

The shoot-off row activates automatically in the Archeris scoring interface as soon as the tie condition is detected — scorekeepers and organizers do not need to manually trigger anything.

2. Individual Shoot-Off Procedure

In individual matches, the tie-break proceeds as follows:

  1. Each archer shoots 1 single arrow on their assigned target face.
  2. The archer with the higher arrow value (e.g. 10 vs 9, or 9 vs 8) wins the match.
  3. If both archers shoot the exact same arrow value (e.g. both score 9, or both score 10):
  4. The winner is determined by measuring which arrow is Closest to the Center (CTC) of the target face.

If both arrows are at the exact same distance from center — which is extremely rare — a coin toss or re-shoot is conducted per the judge's ruling.

3. Team Shoot-Off Procedure

In team matches:

  • Team (3 archers): Each team member shoots 1 arrow (3 arrows total per team).
  • Mixed Team (2 archers): Each team member shoots 1 arrow (2 arrows total per team).
  • The team with the highest cumulative shoot-off arrow total wins.
  • If the total shoot-off scores are tied, the team whose single arrow is closest to the center wins the match. If those are equidistant, the second closest arrows are compared.

Team shoot-offs happen fast — all archers shoot simultaneously. Make sure each team member is at their designated position before the shoot-off command is given to avoid procedural errors.

4. Closest to Center (CTC) Determination

When arrow values are identical in a shoot-off:

  • Judges inspect the target butt with calipers or a precise measuring ruler from the center pinhole of the X-ring to the nearest edge of each arrow shaft.
  • In Archeris, when a scorekeeper or organizer enters tied shoot-off arrow scores, the UI prompts: "Select the archer whose arrow is Closest to Center (CTC) / Beri Tanda Panah Terdekat".
  • Selecting the CTC toggle awards the match victory to that archer, and a (CTC) badge is affixed to the match result.

In practice, CTC decisions happen quickly — judges simply look at which arrow shaft is physically closer to the pin hole at the center of the target face. The system only needs a yes/no selection from the organizer, not a measurement value.

5. Recording Shoot-Offs in Archeris

In the scoring interface (Organizer Dashboard or Mobile Scorekeeper):

  1. When regulation ends finish in a tie, a special S.O. (Shoot-Off) input row automatically activates.
  2. Input the arrow score for Archer A and Archer B (or team arrows).
  3. If scores are different, the system computes the winner automatically.
  4. If scores are identical, tap the CTC Winner radio toggle next to the archer verified by the judges.
  5. Click Save & Finalize Match. The winner is advanced to the next bracket round immediately.

Shoot-off results are permanent — once saved, the match cannot be reopened. Double-check the arrow scores and CTC selection before clicking finalize, especially in high-stakes semifinal and final matches.

id.title: Aturan Shoot-Off
id.excerpt: Pelajari aturan pemecah seri babak eliminasi, prosedur shoot-off satu anak panah, shoot-off beregu, dan penentuan jarak terdekat ke pusat sasaran (CTC).
id.content:
Apabila pertandingan babak eliminasi berakhir dengan skor imbang setelah jumlah set atau rambahan reguler terpenuhi, pemenang ditentukan melalui babak penentuan mendadak yang disebut Shoot-Off (Satu Panah Penentuan).

1. Kapan Terjadinya Shoot-Off?

Shoot-off otomatis dilakukan saat kondisi berikut terjadi:

  • Sistem Set (Individu Recurve / Barebow): Skor poin set berakhir imbang 5 - 5 setelah menyelesaikan 5 set.
  • Sistem Set (Beregu / Mixed Team Recurve): Skor poin set berakhir imbang 4 - 4 setelah menyelesaikan 4 set.
  • Sistem Kumulatif (Individu Compound): Total akumulasi skor sama setelah 5 rambahan (15 anak panah).
  • Sistem Kumulatif (Beregu Compound): Total skor sama setelah 4 rambahan (24 anak panah beregu / 16 anak panah mixed team).

Baris input shoot-off otomatis aktif di antarmuka Archeris segera setelah kondisi seri terdeteksi — scorekeeper dan panitia tidak perlu memicu apapun secara manual.

2. Prosedur Shoot-Off Individu

Pada kategori individu, tahapan shoot-off adalah:

  1. Masing-masing pemanah menembakkan 1 anak panah penentuan ke bantalan sasaran.
  2. Pemanah dengan nilai anak panah lebih tinggi (contoh: 10 vs 9, atau 9 vs 8) keluar sebagai pemenang pertandingan.
  3. Jika kedua pemanah memperoleh nilai panah yang sama persis (misalnya sama-sama 9, atau sama-sama 10):
  4. Pemenang ditentukan berdasarkan anak panah yang posisinya paling dekat dengan titik pusat sasaran / *X-ring* (Closest to Center / CTC).

Jika kedua anak panah berada pada jarak yang persis sama dari pusat — yang sangat jarang terjadi — keputusan diserahkan ke wasit untuk re-shoot atau pengundian.

3. Prosedur Shoot-Off Beregu

Pada kategori beregu:

  • Beregu (3 pemanah): Setiap anggota tim menembakkan 1 anak panah (total 3 anak panah per tim).
  • Beregu Campuran (2 pemanah): Setiap anggota tim menembakkan 1 anak panah (total 2 anak panah per tim).
  • Tim dengan total akumulasi skor anak panah shoot-off tertinggi menang.
  • Jika total skor shoot-off tetap sama, tim yang memiliki 1 anak panah paling dekat ke pusat sasaran (CTC) dinyatakan sebagai pemenang.

Shoot-off beregu berlangsung cepat — semua pemanah menembak secara bersamaan. Pastikan setiap anggota tim sudah berada di posisinya sebelum komando shoot-off diberikan untuk menghindari kesalahan prosedural.

4. Penentuan Jarak Terdekat ke Pusat (CTC)

Saat nilai anak panah shoot-off bernilai sama:

  • Wasit/Juri lapangan akan memeriksa bantalan sasaran menggunakan jangka sorong atau mistar presisi dari lubang pusat X ke tepi terdekat tabung panah (*arrow shaft*).
  • Di aplikasi Archeris, saat wasit/panitia memasukkan skor shoot-off yang seri, antarmuka akan memunculkan pilihan: "Pilih pemanah dengan panah Terdekat ke Pusat Sasaran (CTC)".
  • Memilih opsi CTC akan memenangkan pemanah tersebut dan menampilkan label (CTC) pada riwayat bagan.

Dalam praktiknya, keputusan CTC terjadi cepat — wasit cukup melihat tabung anak panah mana yang secara fisik lebih dekat ke lubang pin di pusat bantalan. Sistem hanya membutuhkan pilihan ya/tidak dari panitia, bukan nilai pengukuran.

5. Pencatatan Shoot-Off di Archeris

Pada layar input skor (Dashboard Panitia maupun Aplikasi Mobile Scorekeeper):

  1. Ketika pertandingan berakhir seri, baris input khusus S.O. (Shoot-Off) akan aktif secara otomatis.
  2. Ketik nilai anak panah Pemanah A dan Pemanah B.
  3. Jika nilai berbeda, sistem langsung menentukan pemenang.
  4. Jika nilai sama, klik tombol pemilih Pemenang CTC pada pemanah yang telah diverifikasi wasit.
  5. Klik Simpan & Finalisasi Pertandingan. Pemenang otomatis dipromosikan ke babak bagan selanjutnya.

Hasil shoot-off bersifat permanen — setelah disimpan, pertandingan tidak bisa dibuka kembali. Periksa nilai anak panah dan pilihan CTC dengan teliti sebelum klik finalisasi, terutama pada pertandingan semifinal dan final yang sangat menentukan.
